items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, yeah, a good friend of mine.

ctx.x: And the next morning, they managed to get that bus down off that mountain, and we headed into Denver. So we played Denver. And I think our next stop was Dodge City, Kansas. And so I said, "This is it." Because I had caught a very bad cold up on that mountain. And I said, "Well, if I go back East in all of this cold weather, I might just go into bad health with this kind of a cold," you know. So I thought it over, and I said, "Wow, I'd better get on back to California" -- and knowing that I had a job that I could…

And I came back. And just like Roy said, he got me into the union, and I played at the Cobra Room with them. And it was really nice. He lived down... He had a little grocery store in the next block down the street, and he also worked across the street at the Rendezvous, which was on the northwest corner upstairs -- the Rendezvous, a club up there after-hours. So we were working...
This was also on San Pedro...
